incident.symptom: Daily Compound Learning was live in runtime and core intelligence skills, but explicit inheritance across every present and future chat/agent/skill was not yet encoded in the chat-learning preflight and top-level agent contract.
incident.root_cause: Runtime capability closure and universal execution-node inheritance were documented in separate layers without one machine-testable cross-layer contract.
incident.prior_evidence: powerhouse-daily-compound-learning-v1 was live on main with verified Outcome Memory, forecast-resolution and daily learning schedules.

prevention: AGENTS.md makes daily compound learning mandatory for every current and future chat, agent, skill, workflow and scheduler.
brain-chat-learning preflight includes the canonical compound-learning learning and human change record.
core continuity, Company Intelligence, Foresight, Self-Improvement and System Map skills inherit one shared fingerprint.
System Map declares agent/chat contracts and next-agent discoverability as runtime invariants.
Regression test fails if any inheritance link is removed.
